sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-live-desk-2026-10-02-r1/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 5 = check 4; Internal Quality Checks row 5 and the row-23 login annotation)
evidence:
RUNTIME FACTS, all stated. Entry path and start command: instruction.md:15 ('Put the application in /app', 'start with node /app/server.js'); integration.md:5. Port: instruction.md:15 ('listen on port 3000 (honour PORT if it's set)'); integration.md:5-6 (3000 on 0.0.0.0). Storage/DB_PATH: instruction.md:15 ('/app/app.db, honouring DB_PATH'); integration.md:7-8; hireops_rules.md:418. Health path: instruction.md:15 ('GET /api/health as a check that never touches the database'); integration.md:9-10. Fixed clock: instruction.md:13 and :17 ('fixed clock'); hireops_rules.md:59-60 ('one stored reference moment, 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z'), matching seed_data.json reference_moment. Seed: instruction.md:15 and :17 (/assets/seed_data.json, copy into /app, /assets unavailable at runtime, seed once, no shipped database). Accounts: instruction.md:19 (seven emails, roles, password Hireops!2026), matching tests/app_context.md:8-16. Stack and dependencies: instruction.md:15, integration.md:3-5. The verifier's less obvious launch assumptions are also told: env -i with PATH/HOME/NODE_PATH/PORT/DB_PATH, uid 65534, a writable copy and a non-/app working directory (test.sh:104-111) are in hireops_rules.md:415-420; the symlink rejection (test.sh:72-83) is in integration.md:16-19. Network is public (task.toml:23,38), so no offline constraint is needed.

GRADED-VERSUS-ASKED. I mapped all 152 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual and 2 gate criteria to public text. The 401/403 discipline is hireops_rules.md:370-372; the 409 cases are :436 and :453; numeric and safe-integer refusal is :83-87; date formats are :299-303; display obligations are section 9 (:391-411); coordinated changes are section 11; every change-desk criterion (hro_desk_*, hro_live_*, hro_whatif_roles, hro_entries_reload, hro_pol_live_keeps_entries, hro_pol_session_resume, hro_pol_focus) maps to section 12 (:484-556) and instruction.md:7-11; hro_keep_revision_terms, hro_keep_rescission_date and hro_pol_uncertain_commit map to instruction.md:3 and :13; the referrer roster to instruction.md:17; phone layout and theme switching are excluded in both instruction.md:5 and the visual prompt. Sign-in is asked (hireops_rules.md:359), so the gate is not grading the unrequired.

ONE UNASKED DEMAND FOUND (bounded). functional/judge.toml:65 (hro_money_precision) and functional/prompt.md:29 (P2) tell the judge to 'open revision through the UI, change only base to101.00 and submit without retyping the three large money fields'. That presumes the revision editor opens pre-filled with the current terms. Neither instruction.md nor hireops_rules.md section 5 (:229-258) says so; instruction.md:13 only requires entered terms to be kept after a refusal. hro_keep_revision_terms (judge.toml:1379, 'together with the unchanged fields') leans on the same assumption more weakly. Weight of hro_money_precision is 0.12056737 of a 74.0 functional total, about 0.16% of the functional dimension.

MINOR WORDING. instruction.md:19 labels the approvers 'Approver, Band I/II/III' while app_context.md:13-15 and hireops_rules.md:32,41 say tier 1/2/3 and :41 warns that tier and band are different things. The seed's authority_tier resolves it; no criterion depends on the label.

NOT MEASURED. check-runtime-contract-strings.py (the mechanical half per quality-checks.md:23) was not run by me; this is a source read. The raw evidence index states that no full configured judge run exists, so no run confirms or refutes the pre-fill counterexample.
counterexample: Conforming alternative that could lose credit: an app whose revision form opens blank and requires all six replacement terms to be typed (hireops_rules.md:236 only says a revision 'can change' the six terms). The judge is told to submit 'without retyping the three large money fields', which is impossible on that form; a literal judge scores hro_money_precision 0 even though the app stores and returns 90071992547409.91 and 70368744177664.01 exactly. Impact is capped at about 0.16% of functional. Broken app that could pass: none found for this row; the health and port facts are backed by gates that require a real saved requisition and offer read back in a separate context (gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-26).
suggested_fix: Either add one public sentence to hireops_rules.md section 5 ('The revision form opens carrying the offer's current six terms, so an unchanged term is resubmitted exactly'), or reword hro_money_precision and P2 to 'leave the large fields as pre-filled, or re-enter the same values if the form opens blank'. Optionally align instruction.md:19 with 'tier 1/2/3'.
